::: {#exm-office-graph}
#### The office graph

The computers and cables of @exr-office-cables form a graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) $G = (V, E)$,
with one vertex for each computer and one edge for each cable:

$$
\ba
V &= \set{a, b, c, d, e, f},
\\
E &= \set{\set{a, b}, \set{a, c}, \set{b, c}, \set{b, d}, \set{c, e}, \set{d, e}, \set{d, f}, \set{e, f}}.
\ea
$$

Here each edge is written as the set of its endpoints:
the edge $\set{b, d}$ joins the vertices $b$ and $d$.
@fig-office draws $G$.
We call $G$ the *office graph*.

:::
